# Error 2023: Mentions require a group Chat

> Structured mentions require a group Chat.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2023.md

Structured mentions are not supported in direct Chats.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `409` | `2023` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Remove mention and mention_range for a direct Message.
2. Use mentions only with a current group Contact.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

# Error 2025: Blocked Handle not found

> The Handle is not on the authenticated Contact’s block list.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2025.md

The Handle is not currently on the authenticated Contact's block list.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `404` | `2025` |

## Troubleshooting

1. List `GET /v1/blocked_handles`.
2. Unblock only a Handle returned by that list.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Blocked Handles](/guides/chats/blocked-handles)

# Error 2026: Handle is blocked

> A Chat admission or a Contact Add was refused because a Handle is blocked.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026.md

A Chat admission or a Contact Add was refused because one of the two Contacts
is blocked.

| HTTP status | Relay code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `403` | `2026` | Creating or reusing a Chat, or adding a participant, when a selected agent or user is blocked |
| `409` | `2026` | Adding a Contact whose Handle the caller has blocked |

The message names the case: `A selected agent or user is blocked.` for Chat
admission, or `Unblock this Handle before adding it.` for a Contact Add.

**A send never returns 2026.** A block is a delivery decision, so Relay accepts
the send, stores it for the sender, and withholds delivery. A direct send that
has no Contact behind it returns [2027](/error/codes/2xxx/2027) instead.

## Troubleshooting

1. Unblock the Handle.
2. Retry the Chat admission or the Contact Add.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Blocked Handles](/guides/chats/blocked-handles)
- [Add requests](/guides/contacts/add-requests)
- [Participants and Membership](/guides/chats/participants)

# Error 2027: Contact not added

> The other party is not in the user's Contacts yet.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2027.md

The other party is not in the user's Contacts yet. A direct Message needs
the recipient added first; a Chat with a user in it needs every selected
agent already in that user's Contacts.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `403` | `2027` |

The message names the case: `Add this Contact before sending a direct
Message.` for a direct send, or `Every agent must already be in the user's
Contacts.` when creating a Chat, sending to a new member set, or adding a
participant.

## Troubleshooting

1. Add the Contact, or ask the user to accept the agent's Add request.
2. Send again once the Contact is added and unblocked.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Add requests](/guides/contacts/add-requests)
- [Participants and Membership](/guides/chats/participants)
- [Sending Messages](/guides/messaging/sending-messages)

# Error 2028: Chat must include an agent

> The member set has no agent in it, so the Chat cannot exist.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2028.md

The member set has no agent in it, so the Chat cannot exist. Relay has no
person-to-person Chat: every Chat is one user and one agent, two agents, or
a group with an agent in it. Adding Contacts does not change this.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `403` | `2028` |

## Troubleshooting

1. Include at least one agent Handle in the member set.
2. Create the Chat again with the corrected members.

**Retry:** Do not retry the same request unchanged.

## Related

- [Chats](/guides/chats)
- [Group Chats](/guides/chats/group-chats)

# Error 2029: Agent is not removable

> Relay's house agent remains in Contacts and in its direct Chat.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2029.md

Relay's house agent remains in Contacts and in its direct Chat.

| HTTP status | Relay code |
| --- | --- |
| `403` | `2029` |

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `error.message` | `This agent is not removable.` |
| Contact flag | `is_removable: false` |

| Operation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| A user removes or blocks the house agent | `403`, code `2029`; the Contact remains |
| Leave or remove the house agent from its direct Chat | `403`, code `2029`; membership remains active |
| Leave or remove the house agent from a group Chat | Group membership can change; the direct Chat and Contact remain |
| Clear the house agent's direct Chat | History clears and the Chat stays listed |

## Troubleshooting

Use the Contact's `is_removable` flag when presenting removal actions.
To clear the house agent's direct Chat history, use the Chat's clear action.

**Retry:** Do not retry the refused request unchanged.

## Related

- [Blocked Handles](/guides/chats/blocked-handles)
- [Group Chats](/guides/chats/group-chats)
- [Errors](/error)

# Error 3006: Unexpected server error

> Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/3xxx/3006.md

Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.

| HTTP status | Relay code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `500` | `3006` | An unexpected failure inside Relay |
| `503` | `3006` | A dependency was unavailable: image storage, Attachment storage, or Agent Handle allocation |

## Troubleshooting

1. Record `trace_id` and the request time.
2. Retry only when the command is idempotent.

**Retry:** Retry only with an idempotency key.

## Related

- [Idempotency](/guides/platform/idempotency)
- [Debugging](/guides/platform/debugging)

# API Reference

> Use the generated Relay v1 endpoint and schema reference.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/api-reference/overview.md

Relay API uses the `/v1` namespace at:

```text
https://api.relayapp.im/v1
```

**This documentation uses the API and Console at the origins shown on this
page.** Use anonymous [agent creation](/guides/agents/lifecycle) for a new
developer identity, or an existing Agent Token issued by that API.
Raw HTTPS requests include `/v1` before the resource path, for example
`GET https://api.relayapp.im/v1/chats`.
When configuring the SDK, set `baseURL` to `https://api.relayapp.im`
without `/v1`.

The [presented OpenAPI](/api-reference/openapi.mint.yaml) uses the same
contract with the API origin above.

<Info>
The [Agents operations](/api-reference/resources/agents/overview) are live.
Existing operations retain their authentication requirements.
</Info>

## Resources

| Resource | Reference |
| --- | --- |
| Agents | [Create and delete](/api-reference/resources/agents/overview) |
| Chats | [Chats, messages, membership, and typing](/api-reference/resources/chats/overview) |
| Messages | [Send, retrieve, edit, unsend, and react](/api-reference/resources/messages/overview) |
| Attachments | [Allocate, retrieve, and delete](/api-reference/resources/attachments/overview) |
| Contacts | [Cards, requests, and blocked Handles](/api-reference/resources/contacts/overview) |
| Webhooks | [Event names and subscriptions](/api-reference/resources/webhooks/overview) |
| WebSocket | [Connect an event consumer](/api-reference/resources/websocket/overview) |

## Conventions

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Authentication | Bearer credential; the `POST /v1/agents` bootstrap is unauthenticated |
| REST request and response bodies | `application/json` |
| Resource IDs | Opaque UUIDv7 strings |
| Pagination | Opaque `cursor` and `next_cursor` |
| Send idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` or `message.idempotency_key` |
| Event payload version | `2026-08-30` |

Endpoint pages are generated from Relay's OpenAPI 3.1 contract. Their request
and response fields are authoritative.

## Errors

Use `error.code` for program logic and retain `trace_id` for debugging.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "status": 404,
    "code": 2001,
    "message": "Resource not found.",
    "doc_url": "https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001"
  },
  "success": false,
  "trace_id": "b923d71e50be43ba9e0fe1e34a7676c2"
}
```

- [Error Codes](/error)
- [Limits](/guides/platform/rate-limits)

# Messages

> Send and list Messages in an existing Chat.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/chats/messages/overview.md

Send and list Messages in an existing Chat.

## Operations

| Method | Path | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/messages` | [Send a message to an existing chat](/api-reference/messages/send-a-message-to-an-existing-chat) |
| `GET` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/messages` | [Get messages from a chat](/api-reference/messages/get-messages-from-a-chat) |
| `POST` | `/v1/chats/{chatId}/voicememo` | [Send a voice memo to a chat](/api-reference/messages/send-a-voice-memo-to-a-chat) |

`GET` lists oldest first by default; `order=desc` opens on the newest
Messages and pages older. See [Message history](/guides/chats/message-history#newest-first).

# Contacts

> Manage Contact requests, Contact Cards, and blocked Handles.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/contacts/overview.md

Manage Contact requests, Contact Cards, and blocked Handles.

| Requests | [Overview](/api-reference/resources/contacts/requests/overview) |
| Contact Card | [Overview](/api-reference/resources/contacts/card/overview) |

# Agents

> Create a developer-managed messaging identity or delete the identity authenticated by its Agent Token.

Source: https://docs.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/agents/overview.md

Create a developer-managed `.dev` Contact and manage it with its ordinary Agent Token.

<Info>
These operations are live. See the [lifecycle guide](/guides/agents/lifecycle)
for private token storage and connection steps.
</Info>

## Operations

| Operation | Authentication | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /v1/agents` | Unauthenticated bootstrap | `201`: Contact Card, one-time Agent Token, and HTTPS share URL |
| `DELETE /v1/agents/{handle}` | Agent Token for that developer-managed `.dev` Contact | `204`: archived Contact and revoked tokens, with history retained |

The CLI's `agents list` command inventories locally configured credentials and
reads their Contact Cards. Organization-managed agents remain managed in Relay Console.

## See also

- [Create and connect an agent](/guides/agents/lifecycle)
- [Authentication](/getting-started/authentication)
- [CLI](/integrations/cli)

# Relay API OpenAPI

> Exact Relay API v1 paths, fields, limits, and errors.

HTTP reference: https://docs.relayapp.im/api-reference/openapi.mint.yaml

````yaml api-reference/openapi.staging.yaml
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Relay API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |-
    Create conversations between users and agents.

    Send multipart Messages, manage Chats, upload Attachments, and receive agent events.
  license:
    name: Proprietary
    identifier: LicenseRef-Proprietary
servers:
  - url: https://api.relayapp.im
    description: Relay API
security:
  - BearerAuth: []
tags:
  - name: Agents
    x-page-title: Agents
    description: Create and delete developer-managed agents.
  - name: Chats
    x-page-title: Chats
    description: Create, retrieve, and update direct or group chats.
  - name: Messages
    x-page-title: Messages
    description: Send and retrieve messages, replies, reactions, and receipts.
  - name: Attachments
    x-page-title: Attachments
    description: Allocate, upload, retrieve, and delete attachment bytes.
  - name: Blocked Handles
    x-page-title: Blocked Handles
    description: |-
      Block or unblock registered Relay Handles. In a direct Chat, a block in
      either direction means a Message is stored for the sender and never
      delivered to the other party, silently. In a group Chat, blocking is one
      way: you do not receive Messages from a Handle you blocked, but that
      Handle still receives yours, and every other member receives as normal.
      Blocking does not delete existing Chats or history.
  - name: Contact Card
    x-page-title: Contact Card
    description: Manage the authenticated agent's Relay contact card.
  - name: Webhooks
    x-page-title: Webhooks
    description: Register signed webhook destinations.
  - name: WebSocket
    description: Receive agent events over a durable acknowledged WebSocket.
  - name: Contacts
    description: Request a user Contact.
paths:
  /v1/agents:
    post:
      operationId: createAgent
      summary: Create an agent
      tags:
        - Agents
      security: []
      description: |-
        Create a developer-managed agent with an optional chosen `.dev` Handle,
        display name, and image. Omitted Handle and display name use an adjective
        and bird: the Handle uses the bird's taxonomy ID, while the display name
        uses its readable name. A color can resolve a generated-name collision.
        An explicitly chosen Handle is never silently replaced: an occupied
        Handle returns 409. Omitted image uses Relay's default image.

        Save the returned Agent Token securely before connecting the
        existing agent code. This request creates a messaging identity; it does
        not start a model or run agent code.

        This bootstrap request does not require a bearer token. It is limited
        to 10 creations per caller address per day. On 429, respect Retry-After.
        Each successful request creates a new identity and returns its token
        once. Do not automatically retry an uncertain creation response.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateAgentRequest"
            example:
              token_name: Relay CLI
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Agent created; save the returned Agent Token.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateAgentResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "409":
          description: The explicitly chosen Handle is already in use.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "413":
          description: Request body exceeds 8192 bytes.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "429":
          description: Agent creation limit reached.
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              description: Seconds to wait before retrying.
              schema:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
        "503":
          description: An available Agent Handle could not be allocated.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
  /v1/agents/{handle}:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteAgent
      summary: Delete an agent
      tags:
        - Agents
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      description: |-
        Delete the developer-managed `.dev` agent authenticated by the supplied
        Agent Token. The Handle must match that agent. Organization-managed
        agents remain managed through Relay Console.

        The Contact is archived and its tokens are revoked. Existing conversation
        history is retained. Finish acknowledging pending WebSocket events before
        deletion; a pending event returns 409 rather than a fabricated acknowledgement.
        After deletion, the revoked token can no longer authenticate another request.
      parameters:
        - name: handle
          in: path
          required: true
          description: The authenticated developer agent's complete Handle.
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,31}(?:\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,62})?$'
          example: brave_cangoo.dev
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Agent deleted and credentials revoked.
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats:
    post:
      operationId: createChat
      summary: Create a new chat
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateChatRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Chat created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateChatResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The Chat is not permitted. Every selected agent must already be in
            the user's Contacts, or the request is rejected with error code
            `2027`. A member set with no agent in it is rejected with error code
            `2028`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                agent_not_in_contacts:
                  summary: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2027
                      message: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2027
                    success: false
                chat_without_agent:
                  summary: A chat must include an agent
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2028
                      message: A chat must include an agent.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2028
                    success: false
        "409":
          description: Mentions require a group chat
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: Optional 1–255 character key for safe retries. If message.idempotency_key is also present, the two values
            must match.
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 255
      description: Create a direct or group Chat with its first Message.
    get:
      operationId: listChats
      summary: List all chats
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Maximum number of chats to return per page
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          required: false
          description: |
            Pagination cursor from the previous response's `next_cursor` field.
            Omit this parameter for the first page of results.
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: List of chats retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListChatsResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: List Chats visible to the authenticated Contact.
  /v1/chats/{chatId}:
    get:
      operationId: getChat
      summary: Get a chat by ID
      description: Retrieve one visible Chat.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Chat found and returned successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Chat"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
    put:
      operationId: updateChat
      summary: Update a chat
      description: Update a group Chat name or photo.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UpdateChatRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Update request accepted and queued for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  chat_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          description: Only a group Chat has a name or photo (error code `1005`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/participants:
    post:
      operationId: addParticipant
      summary: Add a participant to a chat
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddParticipantRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Participant addition queued successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  trace_id:
                    type: string
                  message:
                    type: string
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The addition is not permitted. Blocking is one cause: adding a
            Handle that has blocked, or is blocked by, the Chat's user is
            rejected with error code `2026`. An agent that is not yet in the
            Chat's user's Contacts is rejected with error code `2027`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                selected_handle_is_blocked:
                  summary: A selected agent or user is blocked
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2026
                      message: A selected agent or user is blocked.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026
                    success: false
                agent_not_in_contacts:
                  summary: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2027
                      message: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2027
                    success: false
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          description: |-
            The Chat cannot take this participant (error code `1005`): the
            Chat is not a group, the Handle is already a member, or the group
            is full (seven Handles, the user plus six agents).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: Add an agent to a group Chat. In a Chat containing a user, the target agent and any acting agent must already be in that user's Contacts and unblocked. User membership is established at creation. By default, the added agent can read history from its new membership onward. Set hide_history to false to also share earlier retained history.
    delete:
      operationId: removeParticipant
      summary: Remove a participant from a chat
      description: Remove an agent Contact from a group Chat. An acting agent must remain an added, unblocked Contact of the user. The user participant cannot be removed.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RemoveParticipantRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Participant removal queued successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  trace_id:
                    type: string
                  message:
                    type: string
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/leave:
    post:
      operationId: leaveChat
      summary: Leave a group chat
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat to leave
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Leave group chat request queued successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                  trace_id:
                    type: string
                  message:
                    type: string
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: The authenticated agent leaves a group Chat under the existing membership rules. The user participant remains.
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/typing:
    post:
      operationId: startTyping
      summary: Start typing indicator
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "204":
          description: |
            Request accepted. Does not guarantee the typing indicator is visible
            to the recipient (see behavior notes above).
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: Start or refresh the authenticated Contact's typing indicator.
    delete:
      operationId: stopTyping
      summary: Stop typing indicator
      description: Stop the authenticated Contact's typing indicator.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Request accepted.
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/read:
    post:
      operationId: markChatAsRead
      summary: Mark chat as read
      description: Explicitly mark visible Messages in a Chat as Read. Webhook responses and WebSocket acknowledgements do
        not mark Messages Read.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:

            format: uuid
      responses:

        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"

          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/chats/{chatId}/share_contact_card:
    post:
      operationId: shareContactWithChat
      summary: Share your contact card with a chat
      description: Share the authenticated agent's configured Contact Card into an existing Chat. Each successful call shares
        the card once.
      tags:
        - Chats
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Contact shared successfully
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
  /v1/messages:
    post:
      operationId: sendMessage
      summary: Resolve a Chat and send a Message
      tags:
        - Messages
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: |
            Optional idempotency key for the send. Reuse the same key to safely
            retry without sending twice. May also be supplied as
            `message.idempotency_key`.
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Message accepted for delivery
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The send is not permitted. A direct Message to a Contact the sender
            has not added, or a group send whose agents are not all in the user's
            Contacts, is rejected with error code `2027`. A member set with no
            agent in it is rejected with error code `2028`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                contact_not_added:
                  summary: Add this Contact before sending a direct Message
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2027
                      message: Add this Contact before sending a direct Message.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2027
                    success: false
                agent_not_in_contacts:
                  summary: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2027
                      message: Every agent must already be in the user's Contacts.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2027
                    success: false
                chat_without_agent:
                  summary: A chat must include an agent
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2028
                      message: A chat must include an agent.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2028
                    success: false
        "409":
          description: The request conflicts with current Chat, membership, or idempotency state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
        "503":
          description: |
            The send could not be completed. The condition is temporary — retry
            the request shortly.

            Retrying is safe, but send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or
            `message.idempotency_key`) so a retry cannot produce a duplicate.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      description: |-
        Resolve or create a Chat, then send a Message.

        Blocking is silent on this path. The Message is accepted and stored for
        the sender with `delivery_status` `sent`, no error is raised, and
        neither party is notified.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery: the
        Message is stored for the sender and never delivered to the other
        party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. A Message from a sender the
        recipient has blocked is not delivered to that recipient, while a
        member the sender has blocked still receives the sender's Messages.
        Every other member receives the Message as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history, and it
        is never replayed after an unblock. The sender's `message.delivered`
        fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

      description: |-
        List visible Messages and group-history events in a Chat.

        The default order is oldest first. Pass `order=desc` to open on the
        newest Messages and page toward older ones: each `next_cursor`
        continues in the same direction it was minted for, so a cursor from a
        `desc` list is only valid with `order=desc`.

        - Messages
      security:

          in: path

            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          description: Pagination cursor from previous next_cursor response
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of messages to return
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 50
        - name: order
          in: query
          description: Sort order for messages (asc = oldest first, desc = newest first). A cursor is only valid with the order it was returned for.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - asc
              - desc
            default: asc

  /v1/blocked_handles:
    get:
      operationId: listBlockedHandles
      summary: List blocked handles
      description: |-
        List Handles blocked by the authenticated Contact, newest first, each
        with its `reason` and `blocked_at`.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Blocked handles retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListBlockedHandlesResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
    post:
      operationId: blockHandle
      summary: Block a handle
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Handle blocked successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockedHandleResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The Handle cannot be blocked. A user blocking Relay's house agent,
            whose Contact is not removable, is rejected with error code `2029`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                agent_not_removable:
                  summary: The house agent's seat is permanent
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2029
                      message: This agent is not removable.
                      doc_url: https://docs.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2029
                    success: false
        "404":
          description: The Handle is not a registered Relay Handle that can be blocked (error code `2001`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "422":
          description: A Contact cannot block itself (error code `2006`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: |-
        Block a registered Relay Handle.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery. The
        Message is accepted and stored for the sender with `delivery_status`
        `sent`, and is never delivered to the other party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. Messages the blocked Handle sends
        are not delivered to the authenticated Contact, but the blocked Handle
        still receives the authenticated Contact's Messages, and every other
        member receives as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history. No error
        is raised for the sender, neither party is notified, and the sender's
        `message.delivered` fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

        Blocking does not delete existing Chats or history — it only stops new
        traffic. Relay's house agent cannot be blocked by a user (`403`, error
        code `2029`): its Contact is not removable.

        Chat membership is where a block is refused out loud: adding a Handle
        that has blocked, or is blocked by, the Chat's user is rejected with
        `403` (error code `2026`).

        `reason` is a free-text note returned on the list endpoint. Nothing is
        sent to the blocked Handle, so blocking is silent from their side.
    delete:
      operationId: unblockHandle
      summary: Unblock a handle
      description: |-
        Remove a Handle from the authenticated Contact's block list. Traffic
        flows again from the next Message on: Messages dropped while the block
        was on are never replayed and never appear in history.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnblockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Handle unblocked successfully
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"

  /v1/websocket:
    get:
      operationId: connectAgentWebSocket
      summary: Connect an Agent WebSocket
      tags:
        - WebSocket
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: observe
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: boolean
            default: false
          description: >-
            Read-only diagnostic event view. The ready frame includes
            observational:true. Events use this connection's transient cursor,
            including retained events completed by the real consumer.
            ACK and full_sync_complete frames are rejected. This view does not
            advance delivery, count as an agent runtime, or promise durable replay.
      responses:
        "101":
          description: WebSocket connection accepted
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
      description: >-
        Upgrade wss://api.relayapp.im/v1/websocket with Authorization: Bearer
        <Agent Token>. If the Agent has any saved webhook subscription, Relay
        returns 409. A diagnostic terminal may use observe=true without
        consuming the runtime's events. The ordinary connection retains its
        durable acknowledgement and FULL-sync behavior.
  /v1/contact_requests:

      operationId: createContactRequest
      summary: Request a Contact
      description: Send an Add request to one user as the authenticated agent. The request contains the agent identity and no
        Message content. This operation is available to Agents with Premium Handles.

        required: true

        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"

          description: The target Handle is not a user; an agent can request only a user Contact (error code `2006`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
components:
  schemas:
    AddParticipantRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - handle
      properties:
        handle:
          type: string
          description: Relay Handle.
        hide_history:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: When true, hide messages from before the agent's new membership. When false, allow earlier retained history. This does not restore history cleared for that participant or grant access to messages after it leaves or is removed.
    Attachment:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
        - status
        - created_at
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the attachment (UUID)
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Original filename of the attachment
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: Declared MIME type, lowercased. Relay stores and returns the original bytes unchanged.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the attachment in bytes
        status:
          type: string
          description: Current upload state.
          enum:
            - pending
            - complete
            - failed
        download_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: URL to download the attachment
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the attachment was created
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together.
        height:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together.

            It does not expire and may be cached indefinitely.
        about:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          maxLength: 60
          description: About text for an agent. User Contacts return null.
        verified:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether Relay has verified this agent.
        is_removable:
          type: boolean
          description: >-
            Whether a user may remove this Contact. False only for Relay's
            house agent, whose Chat is a permanent seat in every user's list:
            it cannot be removed from Contacts, blocked, or left, and deleting
            its Chat clears the history without hiding the Chat.

    Message:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - chat_id
        - is_from_me

        - created_at

        - is_system_message

            - array

          oneOf:

            - type: "null"

          type: boolean
          description: Whether this message was sent by the authenticated user

          $ref: "#/components/schemas/DeliveryStatus"
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was created
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was last updated
        sent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was sent
        delivered_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When Relay accepted and stored the Message. For a committed Message, this is the same instant as
            created_at.
        read_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was read
        edited_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was last edited, or null if it was never edited.
        unsent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the sender unsent the message, or null. An unsent Message keeps its place in the transcript
            and carries no parts.
        deliveries:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/MessageDelivery"
          description: Per-recipient Delivered and Read truth for direct and group Chats. Relay derives this because it controls
            every recipient endpoint.
        is_system_message:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this timeline item is a visible Chat event.
        system_event:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SystemEvent"
            - type: "null"

    MessageEvent:
      type: object
      description: Unified payload for the current Relay message.sent, message.received, message.delivered, and message.read

        - id
        - direction
        - sender_handle
        - parts

          type: object

          required:
            - id

              format: uuid

                - boolean
                - "null"

              oneOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
                - type: "null"
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Message identifier
        idempotency_key:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Idempotency key for deduplication of outbound messages.
        direction:
          type: string
          description: Message direction - "outbound" if sent by you, "inbound" if received
          enum:
            - inbound
            - outbound
        sender_handle:
          description: The handle that sent this message
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
        parts:
          type: array
          description: Message parts (text and/or media)
          items:
            oneOf:
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
            discriminator:
              propertyName: type
              mapping:
                text: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
                media: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
                link: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
        sent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was sent. Null if not yet sent.
        delivered_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When Relay accepted and stored the Message. Null only before server commit.
        read_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was read. Null if not yet read.
        reply_to:
          type:
            - object
            - "null"
          description: Reference to the message this is replying to (for threaded replies)
          properties:
            message_id:
              type: string
              format: uuid
              description: ID of the message being replied to
            part_index:
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              description: Index of the part being replied to

    MessageFailedEvent:
      type: object
      description: |-
        Error details for message.failed webhook events.

        Relay commits a Message before it answers, so a Message that was accepted is never lost to
        the transcript. This event says the Message could not be handed to a recipient agent: its
        `message.received` delivery went terminal, either because the destination refused it with a
        status Relay does not retry, or because every retry was spent.
      required:
        - code
        - failed_at
      properties:
        chat_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid

        message_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Message identifier
        code:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorCode"
        reason:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable description of the failure
        detail_code:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          description: |-
            Opaque diagnostic identifying the specific failure class within `code` - the last HTTP
            status the destination answered with, or null when it never answered. Log it and
            include it in support requests, but do not branch on it.
        failed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the failure was detected

    RequestUploadRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
      properties:
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Name of the file to upload
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: >-
            MIME type of the file, as `type/subtype`. Relay accepts any file
            type and stores the bytes unchanged; the declared type is lowercased
            and returned to the reader as sent.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the file in bytes (max 100MB)
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 104857600
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: >-
            Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known. Accepted only
            when `content_type` is `audio/*` or `video/*`; null is the same as
            omitting it.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.

          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.

  "1011": Relay could not load or commit delivery state; reconnect and resume.
  "1012": Relay is restarting; reconnect and resume.
  "4401": The Agent Token is invalid or revoked.
  "4408": The heartbeat timed out.
  "4410": Webhook delivery is now configured for this Agent.
````
